body: That's third same sorting enum in the codebase (see `file_dialog.h` and `file_info.h`). Pretty sure some old one can be reused.

Looks like some duplicate mistake.
```suggestion
```

```suggestion
	tree->set_column_title((int)DependencyEditorColumn::TYPE, TTRC("Type"));
```
Same in all added/changed lines.

This is already initialized
```suggestion
```
Not sure if this is needed. The default separation looks fine.
Unrelated, but this should be removed.

The names don't need to be that verbose.
```suggestion
enum class Column {
```
Like, in outside code typically you'd write `DependencyEditor::Column`, repeating the class in the enum name is redundant.

```suggestion
	void _sort_option_selected(int p_id);
```
More descriptive.

Shouldn't the sorting option be remembered? Why reset it?

And if you happen to delete it `_update_menu_sort()` will become unnecessary.
This doesn't really need to be a dedicated method.

```suggestion
	filter->connect(SceneStringName(text_changed), callable_mp(this, &DependencyEditor::_update_list).unbind(1));
```
`_filter_changed()` is not needed.

The metadata is used with `0` as index. Either usages should be updated or this also need to be changed to `0`.
```suggestion
		item->set_metadata(0, type);
```
Since it's not displayed and technically can be in any column, it's fine to skip the enum in this case.

EDIT:
I noticed the enum is used inconsistently in other places too (like when setting missing dep color few lines above). It'd be nice to update the old code to use the enum columns, but can be done in a separate PR.
This is already checked above. No need to perform it twice, just move this code to the previous condition.
The icons should be set in NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED.

I don't think you need separate structs for reverse sorting. Just sort normally and reverse the result, it should be the same (see how it's done in `file_info.cpp`).

Consequently, the static methods can be part of the structs.

Unfortunately not, because the final column of both refers to the modification time instead of the path. It could be used as long as semantics don't matter, but it seems incorrect to me in this case.

```cpp
enum class FileSortOption {
	FILE_SORT_NAME = 0,
	FILE_SORT_NAME_REVERSE = 1,
	FILE_SORT_TYPE = 2,
	FILE_SORT_TYPE_REVERSE = 3,
	FILE_SORT_MODIFIED_TIME = 4,
	FILE_SORT_MODIFIED_TIME_REVERSE = 5,
	FILE_SORT_MAX = 6,
};
```

In addition to the suggested corrections, I resolved the inconsistencies in the lines above. The main reason I think this needs to be done in this PR is because the `master` branch has 2 columns, while this PR introduces 3 columns (the `"Type"` in column `0`).
Added `const` in other immutable `Strings` (specially in the sort static functions).

I removed the reset from `sort_by`, but unfortunately it's not possible to remove `_update_menu_sort`, because the menu button isn't updated when an option is selected and when the dependency editor window itself is opened.
The suggestion also included removing unnecessary empty line.
